title: Cut-off error estimate for an admissible integral representation
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P k = continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable such that, for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α|_E for every k-covector α (|·|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm). Let ω, η ∈ 𝒟^k(U), χ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ with f continuous, and t, ε, M ∈ ℝ, such that |ω(x)|_E ≤ M for all x, η(x) = χ(x)·ω(x) for all x, 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1, χ(x) = 1 whenever f(x) ≤ t − ε, and χ(x) = 0 whenever f(x) ≥ t. Then |∫_{f<t} ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) − ∫ ξ(x)(η(x)) dμ(x)| ≤ M · μ(tsupport ω ∩ {t − ε < f < t}), the measure on the right being finite and read as a real number (ENNReal.toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (ω η : TestFormOn U k) (χ f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t ε M : ℝ), Continuous f → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ≤ M) → (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, f x ≤ t - ε → χ x = 1) → (∀ x, t ≤ f x → χ x = 0) → |(∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) - ∫ x, ξ x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ| ≤ M * (μ (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ∩ {x | t - ε < f x ∧ f x < t})).toReal
